rejected_rule.statement: The burden of proof was on the plaintiff to prove his title to lots A, B, and C, and he has failed to discharge this burden.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "I say so for this reason. A Dewalagama area, as De Sampayo J. himself indicated in his judgment referred to above, may well include paraveni tenants holdings as well as muttetu. or bandara lands. The admission of the added defendant, that the portion of the Galpatha village depicted in plan PI and therefore that lots A, B, and C in plan P3 were a Dewalagama and that the Dewala was the overlord does not displace the burden of proof, and therefore does not carry the case any further so far as the plaintiff's claim is concerned."

meta.parties: Ratwatte Basnaike Nilame v. De Silva Et Al
